A first visit to Krownlandia

Pick one thing to try. You can explore at your own pace, without completing a task or claiming a reward.

Open Krownlandia Gateway · Explore without 3D

Enter or resume

On a first visit, choose Enter the courtyard. If this browser has a saved spot, Continue exploring returns there. Start at the gate gives you a fresh starting point and keeps your rewards, home, and keepsakes.

  • Keyboard: Use WASD or the arrow keys to walk, Q and R to turn, and E to interact when an action appears.
  • Touch: Use the left pad to walk, drag the scene to look, and tap the action button to interact.

Choose a first stop

  1. For a short introduction, follow the gold trail to Pip and interact when close.
  2. For a quieter visit, open Park menu → Explore → Park map and search for Library of Alexandria. Choose the reading desk result and follow the trail. The Library credits the original place idea to @Jauregui9821.
  3. For a hands-on activity, choose Explore → Community Walk → Village Craft Trail and pick a workshop. The trail links prototype activities inspired by the recorded village traditions.

At a rewards station, arrival points and completed tasks are separate. Open the station to see what you can claim. A craft-trail stop adds no points by itself.

Make the park comfortable

Open Park menu → Settings → Controls & help for more controls, or try Lightweight graphics if movement feels slow. In Settings → Back up progress, you can download a copy of the progress saved in this browser.

Explore without 3D

Browse the Reading Shelf for crafts, illustrated studies, rhythm exercises and puzzles in one place.

The Village Craft Guide has paper activities, the Arts Sampler has paper and spoken exercises, and the Community Bulletin describes recent park features. All three work without JavaScript.

If 3D fails to start and JavaScript is available, the gateway also offers Save a copy of your progress. This exports previously saved data; restoring remains in the park’s normal backup controls.
